data.name: Banour
data.gender_notes: Banour is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'banat' meaning 'sun' and 'our' meaning 'light'. Signifies the radiance and brightness of the sun. The name Banour carries the meaning “Sunlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Banour usually hope their child will grow to embody sunlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies abundance and richness in the spiritual realm
data.etymology: Banour belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sunlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Banour total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
